prompt:

| Return 3m            | +5.8% |
| Return 1m            | -8.2% |
| Return 1w            | +2.3% |
| Range position (63d) | 51% |
| 21d realized vol     | 21% |
| Last close           | 244.71 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:

With no clear directional breakout and moderate volatility (21% 21-day realized), a cautious stance is warranted for the next 20 trading days.

DECISION: HOLD
